column7: How it shows on the sheet

column5: Confuses short and long vowel matras (ि/ी, ु/ू)
column6: Writes the short matra for the long one or the reverse, in words the child can read correctly
column7: The same pair is wrong in two or more dictated words; the consonants are right
column10: Say the word slowly and stretch the long vowel ('दी...दी'); the children show a short or long arm movement before writing. Minimal pairs on the board: दिन/दीन, कुल/कूल.

column4: अनुस्वार, चंद्रबिंदु या मात्रा छोड़ देना (ं, ँ, े/ै)
column5: Leaves out the nasal sign or a matra (ं, ँ, े/ै)
column6: Drops the anusvara or chandrabindu, or writes े for ै, so the word changes or loses its plural
column7: Missing ं/ँ or े↔ै in two or more words; often in है/हैं, में/मैं
column8: बच्चे खेलते हैं। मैं घर में हूँ।
column9: बच्चे खेलते है। में घर मै हू।
column10: Read the sentence back aloud from the child's own writing, word by word: the child hears the missing sound. Keep a small chart of है/हैं, में/मैं on the wall.

column4: शब्दों को जोड़कर या तोड़कर लिखना
column6: Writes two words as one, or breaks one word into parts, because the sentence was heard as one stream
column7: No space between words that belong apart, or a space inside a word, in two or more places
column10: Dictate slowly and clap once for each word; the children count the claps and then the words they wrote. A finger space between words.

column4: वाक्य अलग-अलग लिखना, जोड़ने वाले शब्द नहीं
column5: Writes separate sentences with no joining words
column6: Each sentence stands alone; and, then, because are never used, so the writing reads as a list
column7: Three or more sentences on the topic, none joined by और / फिर / क्योंकि / लेकिन
column8: मेरी बहन का नाम सीमा है। वह स्कूल जाती है और रोज़ पढ़ती है।
column9: मेरी बहन सीमा है। वह स्कूल जाती है। वह पढ़ती है।
column10: Model joining two of the child's own sentences with और and with फिर; then the child joins one more pair from their writing.

column4: वाक्य कहाँ खत्म होता है, यह नहीं दिखाना
column5: Does not mark where a sentence ends
column6: Runs sentences together without the पूर्ण विराम (।), or puts it in the middle of a sentence
column7: Two or more full stops missing or misplaced on the sheet
column8: आज मेला है। हम मेले में जाएँगे।
column9: आज मेला है हम मेले में जाएँगे
column10: The child reads their writing aloud and stops where the voice stops: that is where । goes. Practise on two sentences written together on the board.

column4: एक ही शुरुआत या बात दोहराना
column5: Repeats the same sentence start or idea
column6: Starts every sentence the same way, or says the same thing twice, so the writing does not move on
column7: Three or more sentences begin with the same words, or two sentences say the same thing
column8: मेरा गाँव छोटा है। वहाँ एक तालाब है। गाँव के लोग मेहनती हैं।
column9: मेरा गाँव छोटा है। मेरा गाँव अच्छा है। मेरा गाँव सुंदर है।
column10: Ask 'और क्या बताओगे?' after each sentence; list 3 different things about the topic before writing (what, where, who).

column6: Begins on the topic but later sentences are about something else
column7: One or more sentences not about the given topic
column8: विषय 'मेरा त्योहार': सभी वाक्य दिवाली के बारे में
column9: विषय 'मेरा त्योहार': दो वाक्य दिवाली पर, फिर मेरे दोस्त और क्रिकेट पर
column10: Before writing, the child says the topic in one sentence; after writing, they tick each sentence that is about it and cross the one that is not.

column4: क्रम नहीं: शुरुआत, बीच और अंत नहीं
column5: No order: no beginning, middle and end
column6: Ideas are in a random order; no opening sentence that names the topic and no closing sentence
column7: The first sentence does not introduce the topic, or the paragraph stops without an ending; sequence words (पहले, फिर, अंत में) are missing
column8: पहले हमने घर सजाया। फिर पूजा की। अंत में सबने मिठाई खाई।
column9: सबने मिठाई खाई। हमने घर सजाया। पूजा हुई।
column10: Plan on three lines first: शुरुआत, बीच, अंत. Model with sequence words; the child numbers their sentences in order before copying them out.

column4: बहुत कम लिखना: एक-दो वाक्य, अनुच्छेद नहीं
column5: Writes too little: a sentence or two, not a paragraph
column6: Stops after one or two sentences although the task asks for 5-7
column7: Fewer than 5 sentences on a task that asks for 5-7
column9: मुझे दिवाली पसंद है। हम दीये जलाते हैं।
column10: Give question prompts on the board (कब? कहाँ? कौन? क्या करते हैं? कैसा लगता है?); the child writes one sentence for each.
